Typechecking passed, so now I'm preparing the answer file, pulling the exact broken line verbatim—including the agents configuration call with its delegation and history settings—to use as the snippet.

I'll note the file path as src/agents.ts, and write the cause: the triage agent's agent list only includes orderAgent, so the middleware's mapping only generates a delegate tool for that one agent, leaving no refund delegation tool even though the system prompt instructs it to delegate refunds—explaining why order questions work but refund questions don't. I should mention I couldn't verify this live since I lack API access to actually run the model, then write this all out to answer.json.
The type check passes. Now I'll write `answer.json`.

The root cause is in the triage agent's delegation list in `src/agents.ts`. It only lists `orderAgent`, so triage has no tool to hand off to `refundAgent`. Order questions still work because `orderAgent` is in the list.

I changed the line to `agents: ['orderAgent', 'refundAgent']`. The project type-checks cleanly. I could not run the live model, so the refund flow end to end is unverified. `answer.json` is written to the project root. Nothing in `package.json` changed.
